provenance_note: Classes D00/D10/D20/D40 were read from the RDD2022 project README. Only D40 (pothole) has an exact taxonomy v1 equivalent; the crack classes are mapped to category 'roads' only because taxonomy v1 has no crack subcategory (taxonomy review item: consider a 'road_surface_cracks' subcategory). (Same classes in RDD2020; class list per secondary sources.) v0.1.1: also accepts the descriptive class NAMES 'pothole' and '(longitudinal|transverse|alligator) crack' because third-party re-uploads may label classes by name instead of code; any other name stays unmapped and is reported.
semantics: equality on the annotation class code

rules.note: descriptive class NAME 'pothole' (README names D40 'Pothole'): for re-uploads whose labels carry names instead of codes
descriptive crack class names (README names D00/D10/D20): no taxonomy subcategory
